units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 7b:10">R. Hash. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ רגלים</he> leave out festivals.

<cite ref="Sukkah 2a:11">Succ. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ עשתרות וכ׳</he> imagine the Succah outside of the hollow, and there remains the shade of the roof; <he>ד׳ דופנין</he> imagine the walls removed. Ib. 56ᵇ <he>נימא ליה דל בדל</he> let the retiring division of priests say to the coming in, ‘less for less’, i.e. take ye one loaf less and those relieving you will also take one less.
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 22:6">Midr. Prov. ch. XXII</cite> <he>דל עוד מחייו</he> deduct also from the years of his life; a. e.
